svg.title: Textile worker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as textile worker, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A sewing needle has an elongated eye and one long shaft, threaded with a loose looping strand. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a tapered face.
